text:
noah: Observed unexpected secure_boot=false flips on a handful of racks in us-central1 after a BIOS micropatch roll (v3.02). Started ~15:42 UTC, coincident with the roll. Nodes then failed attestation and the provisioner marked GPUs as unhealthy and evicted them.
tara: Which firmware change triggered it? We only meant to adjust watchdog timers.
noah: The micropatch added an emergency guard that toggles secure_boot off if BIOS init exceeds threshold; looks like the threshold was too low for certain boards and tripped under IO load. Sample from bmc log: ```mgmtd: bios_init: duration=12.8s > threshold=10s -> recovery(action=disable_secure_boot)
attest: attestation: secure_boot=false -> failure```
vik: Ops-bot, show alert counts and affected racks
ops-bot: ALERT: us-central1/oob-secboot 15:43-16:10 UTC: 6 racks toggled, 52 GPUs evicted, 94 allocation retries queued. Autoscaler launched 2 extra nodes.
tara: Immediate plan: 1) rollback guard in firmware to keep secure_boot state unchanged 2) re-enable secure_boot on affected racks 3) temporarily relax provisioner eviction for attestation failures by increasing grace window to 20m.
noah: Re-enable command ready (batch API): ```POST https://mgmt.api.local/batch/command -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" -d '{"cmd":"secureboot set true && systemctl restart attestd"}'```
vik: Rate-limit at 4/s and run against racks in chunks to avoid mgmt fabric overload. I'll kick it off.
ops-bot: Batch job queued (job_us_1715123456). 6/6 racks patched at 16:05 UTC, 0 failures. Sessions normalizing.
tara: Firmware rollback patch committed to canary only. Also adding a preflight that runs a BIOS init timing test on target boards before fleet rollout.
zane: Postmortem items: - remove auto-toggle of secure_boot from guard paths - add attest grace policy for <20m transient failures - instrument mgmt fabric queue depth alert to avoid cascading evictions
noah: Monitoring: new alert if secure_boot toggles >1/rack/hour and provisioner eviction rate >10/min in region.
vik: Leaving rollout paused until we've seen stable metrics for 45m. Update in 20m. :hourglass:
